name: Whispering Horror Residue
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Whispering Horror Residue to Father Lankester in the War Quarter of Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText: What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.I welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, champion. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have something for me, champion?
